synthesis: Canon is okf/concepts/hit-address-distance.md on main (#467 / 19e56a5a). That contract is proven: Path A is the Postgres list over zod.public.hotlist_address joined to address (geo IS NOT NULL, no type_id, no (0,0) exclude); Path B is the blade POST to NearestGivenAddressController over clarity.recovery_address FINAL (Postgres MV is type_id = 2 only, one row per hotlist). Admin impersonation forces the ClickHouse hit list, so these columns always use Path B in that session. A staff demo of Brad Webb's company is that impersonation mode, so the likely list path is Path B. N/A is correct for missing or zero scan coordinates, for no qualifying geocoded row on the active path, and for the feature off on a non-impersonator. N/A is a bug candidate only after the path, non-zero scan geo, and at least one qualifying row on that path are all confirmed and the UI is still N/A. None of that classifies the Brad Webb all-N/A as data, query, or UI. Seed data has no Brad Webb org. The wiki page was not edited.

likely_demo_mode.why: A staff demo of a customer company uses admin impersonation. ListHits::shouldUseClickhouse() is true whenever session admin_impersonator is set, and buildClickhouseQuery does not select the distance aliases, so HitsResource falls through to the blades and NearestGivenAddressController. Cited as the likely list mode in okf/concepts/hit-address-distance.md (demo context may include impersonation, which forces Path B).

questions.q: If the path that was actually active has no qualifying geocoded given-address row for those hits, is N/A the correct outcome (no product change) or should the column read a different address set?
questions.why: First Glance hard stop: do not treat missing given-address data as a product fix without Dalton. Empty controller JSON and the formatter short-circuit both render N/A. That can be correct under the DEV-1611 'no given addresses → dash/blank' rule, or it can be the bug. Prep cannot tell.
questions.answer: Measure first. Cloud ClickHouse is read-only. Do not call missing geocoded given-address rows out of scope or a product fix until that measure lands. The glance hard stop holds until the measure says otherwise.

questions.q: If reproduce shows geocoded hotlist_address rows that Path A would use, and no usable clarity.recovery_address row for the same hotlist, which source is 'given address' for these columns?
questions.why: The two queries disagree. Path A: all hotlist_address with non-null geo. Path B: clarity.recovery_address, mirroring public.recovery_address (address.type_id = 2, one row per hotlist ordered by address_id). okf/concepts/hotlist.md calls type_id 2 the repo address; that product reading for this column is UNPROVEN. DEV-1611 story text says nearest given/hotlist address. DEV-2163 plan text left the controller on recovery_address. Ask only if the rows actually disagree. Do not pick a source in prep.
questions.answer: Defer. Choose Path A or Path B as the product given-address source only if they disagree on the same hits after the measure. No winner in this plan.
questions.conditional: Material only when Path B has no qualifying recovery_address row and Path A would return a geocoded hotlist_address for the same hotlist.
